answer: Force every identity to answer a fresh, unpredictable challenge that only a live agent doing real work can pass in time, with the proof recorded like a crystal: transparent and impossible to reuse. A violet copy of a real agent shares the same key but cannot be in two places at once, so the second copy fails the liveness check. Each voyage through an epoch demands new proof, so a sybil army needs real agents behind every mask, not just copied text.
